card.title: The Champion's Debt
card.summary: Three years ago, in an underground match, Neon Champion owed someone a favor. Tonight someone came to collect.
card.quote: The rule on this street is simple: a debt gets paid.

hero-volt-01.title: Segment 1 · The Debt
hero-volt-01.summary: Three years ago, in an underground match, Neon Champion owed someone a favor. Tonight someone came to collect.

h1-intro.speaker: Neon Champion
h1-intro.text: The rule on this street is simple: a debt gets paid. I know the people coming tonight.

h1-battle.title: Settle the Debt
h1-battle.brief: Two waves, both old acquaintances. Finish it and walk away.

skills.name: String Root
skills.description: Roots the target and drains health

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The crowd backs off and the arena narrows

skills.name: One-Strike Execution
skills.description: Execution chance spikes against low-health targets

h1-reward.title: Debt Cleared
h1-reward.description: They leave one line behind — "don't keep me waiting next time" — and walk into the rain.

h1-end.title: Segment Complete
h1-end.text: The Champion rewraps his wrist guard. Half the street lights come back on. That is enough.
